name: nfl_player_v3_listed_emp
label: MARKET_SELECTED_POPULATION
what_is_market_selected: the POPULATION: only contracts the exchange lists are scored, and P(involved)=1 for a listed player not reported Out (calibrated to that population)
what_is_market_independent: every model input: usage EWMA states, role shares, team/opponent ratings, game-lab predictions, report status, shape pools; no price, line or consensus is read by the model
definition:
Prospective evaluation of the declared player candidate `v3_listed_emp` -- a SEPARATE experiment from nfl_totals_v1 (RESEARCH_ONLY; no orders; no market price is a model input).

LABEL: MARKET-SELECTED POPULATION.  Two different things are kept apart:
  * inputs      every feature is market-free (usage states, role shares, opponent/team ratings, game-lab predictions, report status, shape pools) -- no price, no line, no consensus
  * population  the set of players scored is the set the exchange chose to LIST.  Listing is selection information produced by the market.  v3 additionally ASSUMES a listed player who is not
                reported Out is involved (P_inv = 1): that assumption is calibrated to this population and must not be read as a market-independent estimate of availability.
Declared model: P(YES) = 1[not reported Out] x P(stat >= k | involved); P(stat >= k | involved) = local-empirical ratio distribution for yardage families (shape chosen on 2022-24 validation) and the
negative binomial / Poisson of the player lab for receptions and any-TD.  Coefficients fitted on seasons <= 2024 (not refit); features advance with 2026 play-by-play.
Evaluation uses the same claim gate as the totals experiment but its OWN multiple-testing family (never pooled with totals); unit = game.
coefficients: fitted on seasons <= 2024 (PlayerLab walk-forward fit), not refit during 2026; features advance with 2026 play-by-play
shape: local-empirical ratio distribution for rec_yds, rush_yds, pass_yds (pools: out-of-sample 2017-2024 predictions, K=300); NB/Poisson from the player lab for receptions and any-TD
evidence_so_far_NOT_A_HOLDOUT: research/audit/lab/player_bias_audit.json (2025 contracts, already examined): v3 vs market log-loss gain pass -0.014 [CI includes 0]; rec_yds -0.020, rush -0.021, receptions -0.014, any-TD -0.016 (CIs below 0)

evaluation.decision_rules: identical to nfl_totals_v1 (latest prediction generated before the decision; complete observation of the contract's series within 30 min; unit = game)
evaluation.claim_gate: PP.claim_gate with its own multiple-testing family (never pooled with totals)

claims_policy: No profitability claim. A pass of the gate is PASS_PROVISIONAL only, and would apply to the market-selected population, not to an arbitrary player.
